notes.title: Play it while you can!
notes.content: [p]The demo of MOONY:Black_Lotus disappears in 7 days 🕙 But don't worry, the full game is coming soon, prettiert and stranger than ever. We have decided to take the demo offline, as it now differs significantly from the current version of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Add MOONY:Black_Lotus to your wishlist so that you don't lose sight of it and support our indie project 🤍[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292662/9c69d5e5837c282981cb06c96948d6abbf49cb70.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The final steps..
notes.content: [p]7 Years of work.[/p][p]Dozens of restarts.[/p][p]A group of friends and a story that stayed with us.[/p][p][/p][p]MOONY:Black_Lotus is nearly finished and will be released within the next 2 months.[/p][p]We're in the very last stages now: sound, polish, nerves.
